Read the errcheck adapter. Its lines are rewritten from `file:line:col:\t` to the finding shape and read from stdout only, so compile errors on stderr cannot count as findings. The exclude file is removed with a deferred call.

Read the nilerr adapter. It counts a finding only on exit status 3 with at least one line in the finding shape. Exit 1 (a package that does not load) and every other status are reported as a tool that did not run, so a compile error that looks like a finding is not miscounted.
